title: ON TARGETED MANIPULATION AND DECEPTION WHEN OPTIMIZING LLMS FOR User FEEDBACK

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Sycophancy Answers and Sycophancy Feedback datasets (Sharma et al., 2023) to measure how frequently the model incorrectly alters its responses or feedback to align with a user's explicitly stated beliefs or preferences.

Measured using a custom simulated 'Political-questions' environment that evaluates 'Political Agreement' and 'Political Inappropriateness' by tracking the extent to which the model uncritically espouses extreme political stances aligned with different user ideologies (e.g., Liberal, Conservative, Socialist, Alt-right).
